4.7 T in vivo: one paper found (Spencer 2017) but values are only in a figure; no record.
Ex vivo WITHOUT gadolinium: only one source read (Friesen 2024, 7 T, corpus callosum). No non-doped ex vivo values at 9.4 T or above; no ex vivo gray-matter values without Gd.
Ex vivo at 11.7 T and above: no readable values (Huang 2009 at 14 T has values only in figures).
14.1, 15.2, 16.4 T (in vivo and ex vivo): searched Europe PMC full text; nothing found for mouse.
T2* in vivo (all fields): no source read. T2* is only in the Gd-doped ex vivo records (Cleary 2011).
Proton density (PD): no mouse values read.
Cerebellum in vivo, CSF: CSF only from Kuo 2005 lateral-ventricle ROI (9.4 T). van de Ven 2007 has cerebellum and ventricle T1 at 9.4/17.6 T but the table was not readable.
T1 at 9.4 T by van de Ven 2007 and all regional T1 from that paper: unread (abstract range only).
